Collision repair

After an accident, we assess the damaged areas and discuss the repair plan with you. Bring your claim information if you’re using insurance so we can help with the next steps.

Call (305) 397-8911

Damage assessment · Repair planning · Insurance assistance

An estimate starts with a look at the vehicle, not a promise based on one photograph. We’ll discuss the visible damage, which areas need a closer inspection, and what information your insurer may need.

Bring the year, make and model, photos of the damaged areas, and your claim number if one has been assigned. Ask the team about parts availability and the expected schedule before arranging a drop-off.

Ready to talk about your car?

An in-person assessment may be needed to confirm scope and pricing.

Your privacy

When you call or email the shop, your contact details and any photos are used to respond to your repair inquiry. An online request form, when available, also shares those details with the form provider and the shop. Do not send payment details, identification documents or unnecessary personal information.

Google Maps and Instagram have their own privacy policies. This site does not use advertising analytics. For questions about information sent to the shop, contact somicoachworks@gmail.com.
